dedupe_keys.name: longitudinal dataset of human building interactions in us offices philadelphia one year

description: This dataset gives one year of longitudinal data at 15-minute intervals on local thermal conditions, related behaviours and thermal comfort of 24 occupants of a medium-sized office building in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. It was published on Zenodo on 25 July 2019 by Jared Langevin of Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory. A codebook defines every variable and its column number in the raw text data, and a zipped file holds the full year of observations. Coverage is one office building and 24 occupants. Access: a zipped text file of about 20 MB and an Excel codebook on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: one building and a small sample; the study year is not stated in the record. Simulation uses: developing and validating occupant behaviour and comfort models, such as agent-based models of window, fan, heater and clothing adjustments, for building energy simulation. Related records: the BuildOcc LLM occupant agents and ROBOD occupancy data.
name: Longitudinal dataset of human-building interactions in US offices (Philadelphia, one year)
